```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(patchwork)
```


```{r}
## Sample map for linking patient id with sample file name
ID <- c("UC2", "UC4", "UC5", "UC7", "UC10", "UC11", "UC13", "UC14", "UC18", "UC19", "UC26", "UC34")
Tumor <- c(2, 4, 5, 7, 10, 11, 13, 14, 18, 19, 26, 34)
Normal <- c(28, 4, 38, 33, 43, 44, 13, 1, 26, 10, 19, 42)
  
sample.map <- data.frame(ID = ID, Tumor = Tumor, Normal = Normal) %>%
  mutate(Tumor = paste0("T",Tumor),
         Normal = paste0("N",Normal))

## Loop through each patient and process tumor and normal samples
files <- list.files(path = "/mnt/storage/peter/steve_aa/vcfs_UTUC_genomes/", pattern = "SNV")

all_vaf <- list()
for(n in ID) {
  message("Working on ", n)
  ## What samplename for tumor and normal is patient
  t.num <- sample.map %>% dplyr::filter(ID == n) %>% pull(Tumor) %>% paste0("_", .,"_")
  n.num <- sample.map %>% dplyr::filter(ID == n) %>% pull(Normal) %>% paste0("_", .,"_")
  ## What file name
  t.file <- files[grepl(pattern = t.num, x = files)]
  n.file <- files[grepl(pattern = n.num, x = files)]
  
  t.data <- data.table::fread(paste0("/mnt/storage/peter/steve_aa/vcfs_UTUC_genomes/", t.file), skip = "#CHROM")
  t.data[, c("DP","FDP", "SDP", "SUBDP","AU","CU","GU","TU") := data.table::tstrsplit(TUMOR, ":", fixed=TRUE)]
  t.data[, AU := as.numeric(tstrsplit(AU, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]])]
  t.data[, CU := as.numeric(tstrsplit(CU, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]])]
  t.data[, GU := as.numeric(tstrsplit(GU, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]])]
  t.data[, TU := as.numeric(tstrsplit(TU, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]])]
  t.data[, vaf := {
    alt_counts <- fifelse(ALT=="A", AU,
                  fifelse(ALT=="C", CU,
                  fifelse(ALT=="G", GU,
                  TU)))

  as.numeric(alt_counts) / as.numeric(DP)
  }]
  
  t.data[, alt_counts := {
    alt_counts <- fifelse(ALT=="A", AU,
                  fifelse(ALT=="C", CU,
                  fifelse(ALT=="G", GU,
                  TU)))
    as.numeric(alt_counts)
  }]
  
  t.data$group <- n
  t.data$type <- "T"
  
  t.data <- t.data %>% dplyr::select(group, type, vaf, alt_counts, DP)
  
  n.data <- data.table::fread(paste0("/mnt/storage/peter/steve_aa/vcfs_UTUC_genomes/", n.file), skip = "#CHROM")
  n.data[, c("DP","FDP", "SDP", "SUBDP","AU","CU","GU","TU") := data.table::tstrsplit(TUMOR, ":", fixed=TRUE)]
  n.data[, AU := as.numeric(tstrsplit(AU, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]])]
  n.data[, CU := as.numeric(tstrsplit(CU, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]])]
  n.data[, GU := as.numeric(tstrsplit(GU, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]])]
  n.data[, TU := as.numeric(tstrsplit(TU, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]])]
  n.data[, vaf := {
    alt_counts <- fifelse(ALT=="A", AU,
                  fifelse(ALT=="C", CU,
                  fifelse(ALT=="G", GU,
                  TU)))

  as.numeric(alt_counts) / as.numeric(DP)
  }]
  
  n.data[, alt_counts := {
    alt_counts <- fifelse(ALT=="A", AU,
                  fifelse(ALT=="C", CU,
                  fifelse(ALT=="G", GU,
                  TU)))
    as.numeric(alt_counts)
  }]
  
  n.data$group <- n
  n.data$type <- "N"
  
  n.data <- n.data %>% dplyr::select(group, type, vaf, alt_counts, DP)
  
  all_vaf[[n]] <- combined_res <- rbind(t.data, n.data)
}

all_vaf <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, all_vaf))

## Now do kidney 7 independently (Distant normal) - UC7 had an extra normal sample
n.data <- data.table::fread(paste0("/mnt/storage/peter/steve_aa/vcfs_UTUC_genomes/AA_UTUC_Taiwan_N7_kidney_SNVintersect.vcf.gz"), skip = "#CHROM")
n.data[, c("DP","FDP", "SDP", "SUBDP","AU","CU","GU","TU") := data.table::tstrsplit(TUMOR, ":", fixed=TRUE)]
n.data[, AU := as.numeric(tstrsplit(AU, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]])]
n.data[, CU := as.numeric(tstrsplit(CU, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]])]
n.data[, GU := as.numeric(tstrsplit(GU, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]])]
n.data[, TU := as.numeric(tstrsplit(TU, ",", fixed=TRUE)[[1]])]
n.data[, vaf := {
    alt_counts <- fifelse(ALT=="A", AU,
                  fifelse(ALT=="C", CU,
                  fifelse(ALT=="G", GU,
                  TU)))

  as.numeric(alt_counts) / as.numeric(DP)
  }]

n.data[, alt_counts := {
    alt_counts <- fifelse(ALT=="A", AU,
                  fifelse(ALT=="C", CU,
                  fifelse(ALT=="G", GU,
                  TU)))
    as.numeric(alt_counts)
  }]
  
n.data$group <- "UC7"
n.data$type <- "Kidney"
  
n.data <- n.data %>% dplyr::select(group, type, vaf, alt_counts, DP)

## Append UC7DN to data
all_vaf <- rbind(all_vaf, n.data)
all_vaf <- all_vaf %>% mutate(hr_type = case_when(type == "T" ~ "Tumor",
                                                  type == "N" ~ "Normal",
                                                  type == "Kidney" ~ "Kidney"))
## Convert UC4 distant normal to Bladder
all_vaf[which(all_vaf$type == "N" & all_vaf$group == "UC4"), "hr_type"] <- "Bladder"

## Factor order
all_vaf$group <- factor(x = all_vaf$group, 
                        levels = c("UC2", "UC4", "UC5", "UC7", "UC10", "UC11", "UC13", "UC14", "UC18", "UC19", "UC26", "UC34"))

all_vaf$hr_type <- factor(x = all_vaf$hr_type, levels = c("Tumor", "Normal", "Kidney", "Bladder"))

## Color annotation
type_anno <- c("#A6A6A6", "#4F81BD", "#E9C46A", "#6A4C93")
names(type_anno) <- c("Normal", "Tumor", "Kidney", "Bladder")

p1 <- ggplot(data = all_vaf, aes(x = vaf, fill = hr_type)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.025, position = "identity", alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = type_anno) + 
  facet_wrap(.~group, scale = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  ylab("Frequency") + xlab("VAF") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = c(0.65, -0.15),
        legend.justification = c(1,0),
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.key.size = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold")
        )

layout <- "
AAAAAAAA
AAAAAAAA
AAAAAAAA
AAAAAAAA
AAAAAAAA
AAAAAAAA
GGGGGGGG
GGGGGGGG
GGGGGGGG"

dev.off()

combined_plot1 <- p1 + plot_layout(design=layout) + 
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c(""))) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 10,
                                margin = margin(-8, 0, -4, -8)),
        text = element_text(family = "Arial"))

ggsave("/mnt/data1/peter/repo/AAmanu/figure/supplementalfigure1.png", 
       width = 170, height = 170,
       units = "mm", dpi = 600)
```
